description: This is a shell script for configuring iOS signing settings, including detection of team ID, bundle IDs, and signing style, and generating a configuration file with these parameters.

methods.name: sanitize_identifier_segment
methods.description: Sanitizes input string to create a safe identifier segment by converting to lowercase and replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens.

methods.name: normalize_bundle_id
methods.description: Normalizes a bundle ID to ensure it conforms to format rules, replacing invalid characters with hyphens and trimming trailing dots or hyphens.
